issue_details.description: a loud noise was observed from the motor/gearbox area. The gear oil was drained for inspection, and metal shavings were found on the drain plug. The team also raised a concern about whether the originally used gearbox oil matches the oil currently used for refilling in the US. Additionally, the charger box mounting bracket was found contacting the front driver-side fender, causing a squeaking noise.
issue_details.rca: The exact root cause of the motor/gearbox noise and metal shavings has not yet been confirmed. The gearbox oil specification and compatibility with the oil used for refilling in the US need to be verified. The squeaking noise appears to be caused by physical contact between the charger box mounting bracket and the front driver-side fender. Further inspection is required to confirm the root causes and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
